description: This file contains implementation of WiFi HAL wrapper functions for interacting with WiFi hardware via low-level APIs. It includes functions for applying settings, getting/setting boolean, unsigned long, string, int, and unsigned int parameters, as well as initialization routines and command handling logic.

classes.name: WIFIHAL
classes.description: This class encapsulates methods for initializing and executing WiFi HAL commands, including parameter get/set operations for various data types and handling the overall lifecycle of the WiFi HAL interaction.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WiFi HAL wrapper, preparing it for command execution.

methods.name: testmodulepre_requisites
methods.description: Sets up pre-requisites necessary before executing WiFi HAL commands, such as HAL initialization.

methods.name: testmodulepost_requisites
methods.description: Cleans up or resets configurations after WiFi HAL command executions.
